1_schema_acceptance.name: SCHEMA_ACCEPTED
1_schema_acceptance.condition: Provider accepts registered wire request body without 400 Bad Request or schema rejection, returns valid structured JSON.

2_raw_persistence.name: RAW_RESPONSE_DURABLY_PERSISTED
2_raw_persistence.condition: Full candidate response text/bytes are durably written to execution directory via atomic write (temp file -> flush -> fsync -> os.replace -> read-back verification) before any parsing or scoring begins.

3_response_parsing.name: RESPONSE_PARSE_VALID
3_response_parsing.condition: Persisted payload conforms to JSON and parses successfully via RequestContract boundary without Pydantic schema validation crashes.

closed_outcome_classification.definition: Provider accepted schema, raw response durably persisted and verified, response parsed, semantics valid, downstream pipeline executed to answer 30.
Provider accepted schema and raw response persisted, but canonical response lacks or has incorrect semantic facts. Prompt/schema must NOT be patched in same wave.
Gemini provider rejected request body with schema incompatibility or HTTP 400. Stop immediately, 0 retries.
HTTP 5xx, network timeout, rate limit, or transport abort.
Persistence failed, read-back hash mismatch, parsing harness error, evaluator error, or pipeline harness error. Cannot classify as model failure.
